396:t_000:7.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You seem kind of lost in thought. ...Are you still thinking about what happened this afternoon?」

396:t_000:8.en:
$$レド$$
「...Everyone scolded me afterward. They said that was a creature called an octopus, not a $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

396:t_000:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You pulled a gun out of nowhere, so it startled me a little.」

396:t_000:11.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hey... more importantly, did you actually watch us dance...?」

396:t_003:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$! I won't let you near $$ガルガンティア$$... near $$エイミー$$!」

396:t_004:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Collect body tissue samples. Amplify and analyze the genes.」

396:t_004:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. However, it is unlikely that the results will differ from the characteristic response analysis.」

396:t_004:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I know. I want to find out whether Earth's $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ have any traits peculiar to them.」

396:t_004:5.en:
$$レド$$
(The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ invasion has reached even this Earth...? Could they have been transferred here along with me...?)

396:t_004:6.en:
$$レド$$
(But if those are the creatures Captain $$ジェフリー$$ notified us about, the $$クジライカ$$ or whatever they're called, then they existed before I was transferred here...)

396:t_004:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. Biological analysis is possible, but no information on the target's invasion strategy can be obtained.」

396:t_004:8.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll gather information from the fleet. We need to know their total numbers and range of activity.」

396:t_004:9.en:
$$レド$$
「As soon as that's done, I'll wipe them out.」

396:t_100:0.en:
$$レド$$
「It seems these things evolved to adapt to life underwater...!」

396:t_100:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Recommendation. This unit's movement is restricted underwater.」

396:t_100:2.en:
$$レド$$
「We do it anyway! We can't let the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ live!」

401:t_1:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...Destruction of the last individual confirmed.」

401:t_1:5.en:
$$レド$$
「That about clears them out. They were more fragile than I expected.」

401:t_1:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Presumed to be degenerative adaptation due to the absence of natural predators.」

401:t_1:7.en:
$$レド$$
「Once safety is secured, I'll contact $$ピニオン$$ on the surface.」

401:t_1:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It appears the remaining Earth-type $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ have fled.」

401:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll wipe them out later. First, we investigate the inside of the nest.」

401:t_1:11.en:
$$レド$$
「...Those small humanoid creatures we saw on the way... What were they...」

401:t_1:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Presumed to be $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ in the middle of growth.」

401:t_1:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Those are $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ young...?」

401:t_1:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Much about the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ life cycle remains unknown. This is valuable information.」

401:t_1:15.en:
$$レド$$
「But what is this place...? It looks like some kind of facility...」

401:t_1:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Inference based on a synthesis of information from $$ピニオン$$: this is judged to be a facility of a civilization already destroyed in the world where the $$残されの海$$ existed.」

401:t_1:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In addition, this location is presumed to be the facility's management block.」

401:t_1:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Can we get any information out of it?」

401:t_1:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Recovered what is presumed to be a recording medium for extreme environments.」

401:t_1:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Medium access successful. Searching for the applicable data standard.」

401:t_1:22.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Similar standard found. Activating inference engine. Attempting restoration and translation.」

401:t_1:25.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Disclosure of the data is impossible.」

401:t_1:27.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This facility has been determined to be a research facility of the old-world civilization.」

401:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
「Then... the $$残されの海$$ exists in the same world as the $$人類銀河同盟$$, and this place was truly the birthplace of life for the Alliance...」

401:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The details of this data conflict with classified matters of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

401:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
「Classified...! What good is that at a time like this!?」

401:t_1:31.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is military regulation.」

401:t_1:32.en:
$$レド$$
「Consider the current situation! When contact with the main force is lost, the highest-ranking person on site holds command! Right!?」

401:t_1:34.en:
$$レド$$
「Who is the highest-ranking person here!」

401:t_1:35.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is Ensign $$レド$$.」

401:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ requests that Chamber, the Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System, disclose the classified information.」

401:t_1:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Carrying out the order.」

401:t_1:42.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「...Now is the time for humanity to overcome its unfortunate wars and begin walking on its own two feet.」

401:t_1:43.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「As part of that effort, we have invited Mr. $$ライアン・マツモト$$, a member of the tirelessly active $$イボルバー$$.」

401:t_1:44.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Thank you for having me.」

401:t_1:45.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Today's special news program will be broadcast live.」

401:t_1:46.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Mr. $$マツモト$$. I hear you have something important to tell us today...」

401:t_1:47.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Yes... I'd like people to learn a little about our activities.」

401:t_1:48.en:
$$マツモト$$
「As residents of an Earth that has fallen into irreversible circumstances, I would like everyone watching this program to think about the future together with me.」

401:t_1:49.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「I hear the $$地球連邦$$ Assembly is pushing emigration to the Moon and leaning toward waiting for the environment to recover on its own.」

401:t_1:50.en:
$$マツモト$$
「I have no intention of denying that. We simply chose not to wait for things to improve, but to carve out the future with our own hands.」

401:t_1:51.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「However, the Spontaneous Evolution Promotion Faction you belong to, commonly known as the $$イボルバー$$, has provoked various kinds of backlash in many places.」

401:t_1:52.en:
$$マツモト$$
「...This is speculation, but I believe someone is instigating it.」

401:t_1:53.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「And who might that be?」

401:t_1:54.en:
$$マツモト$$
「The details are still under investigation, but they lurk in the shadows of history and are people who seek to manage humanity's evolution as if they were gods.」

401:t_1:55.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「This is... a shocking statement...」

401:t_1:56.en:
$$マツモト$$
「The fall of that giant meteorite has subjected Earth to a trial known as nuclear winter.」

401:t_1:57.en:
$$マツモト$$
「I admit that, until now, not much has been said about the $$イボルバー$$' activities, and that this has invited misunderstanding.」

401:t_1:58.en:
$$マツモト$$
「It is also true that many people fear hasty scientific development will destroy old traditions and harm human happiness.」

401:t_1:59.en:
$$マツモト$$
「But along with scientific progress, religion, tradition, and the way people live have also changed.」
